# StudyKarle

> StudyKarle is a student-focused platform for organized engineering notes,
> previous-year papers, assignments, lab files and semester-wise study
> materials.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.studykarle.me/)
- [Features](https://www.studykarle.me/features)
- [How StudyKarle works](https://www.studykarle.me/how-it-works)
- [About StudyKarle](https://www.studykarle.me/about)
- [Contact](https://www.studykarle.me/contact)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.studykarle.me/privacy)
- [Terms of service](https://www.studykarle.me/terms)

The authenticated library and individual files are not listed here because
access is controlled by the StudyKarle application.
